youtube.title: Surah Quraysh (106:1-4) · سورة قريش
youtube.description:
Surah Quraysh (106:1-4) · سورة قريش

لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ ﴿١﴾
1. For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ ﴿٢﴾
2. Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ ﴿٣﴾
3. Let them worship the Lord of this House,

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ ﴿٤﴾
4. Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

Recitation: Tawfiq As-Sayegh
Translation: Sahih International
Word meanings: التفسير الميسر، مجمع الملك فهد
